instructions: Keep existing Job parameters. Add these definitions manually after local acceptance; store the integration key only in Secret Text credential omniqa-surveymaster.

parameters.name: OMNIQA_DRY_RUN
parameters.description: Validate scripts without devices or Zentao result writeback

parameters.name: OMNIQA_URL
parameters.description: Platform site root reachable from the Jenkins agent; configure before enabling

parameters.name: OMNIQA_REPOSITORY_ID
parameters.description: Platform repository ID; configure before enabling

parameters.name: AUTOMATION_RUN_ID
parameters.description: Filled by platform; leave empty for direct Jenkins runs

parameters.name: TEST_REVISION
parameters.description: Exact Git commit for platform runs

parameters.name: ZENTAO_CASE_IDS
parameters.description: Comma-separated mapped case IDs for direct Jenkins runs

parameters.name: ZENTAO_TESTTASK_ID
parameters.description: Dedicated testtask ID for direct Jenkins runs
